propositions: Code review currently lacks a dedicated concurrency correctness criterion despite four traced production races in the codebase; a lockset-first overlay must be added as a Pass-1 specialist.

The overlay uses a two-tier deterministic lexical trigger: a committed high-precision tier (stack-agnostic, fires only on explicit sync primitives) and a project-extensible noisy tier (in .rebar/criteria_routing.json) to catch modal unlocked-twin races.

The committed tier deliberately does not fire on the codebase's modal race class (unlocked whole-index git operations and getmtime-then-remove on index.lock), relying on project vocabulary to close that recall gap.
A code-review diff containing an unlocked-twin race must surface a Pass-1 concurrency finding when evaluated with rebar's project routing.
Built-in overlays must support extensible trigger vocabulary and applies_to globs through .rebar/criteria_routing.json without code modification.
The concurrency overlay ships in advisory mode (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and must not escalate to the reviewer dimension without an accompanying prompt.
